**Top themes:** Charges & fee transparency (116 reviews, avg 2.3); Mutual fund & SIP experience (92 reviews, avg 2.1); App stability & performance (15 reviews, avg 1.7); Customer support & resolution (12 reviews, avg 1.4); Portfolio & reporting (7 reviews, avg 3.3)

**What users are saying**  
> Why does Groww not show exit load before I hit redeem? Charged 150 rupees on a 6 day holding. Hidden fees vibes.  
> Redeemed my mutual fund for an emergency expense at 11 days and somewhere ₹487 vanished between shown and received. Support took days to even tell me it was exit load. Rest of the experience is genuinely smooth.  
> App crashed twice during market hours today. Lost a good entry on a limit order.

**Key observation:** Mentions of the exit‑load fee fell from 32 in the first half of the window to 20 in the second half, but the proportion of confused users remained high (38 of 52 mentions, 73%). The drop likely reflects fewer redemptions as users adjust behavior, while the persistent confusion stems from the fee not being disclosed before the redemption step.

**Actions for the product team:**  
1. Add a pre‑redemption disclosure banner that shows the applicable exit load based on holding period.  
2. Include an inline tooltip on the redemption screen explaining the fee calculation and linking to a detailed FAQ.  
3. Implement a post‑redemption summary that itemises all charges, highlighting any exit load applied.

Hi team,

## 1. Weekly product pulse (week ending 2099-01-01)

**Top themes:** Charges & fee transparency (116 reviews, avg 2.3); Mutual fund & SIP experience (92 reviews, avg 2.1); App stability & performance (15 reviews, avg 1.7); Customer support & resolution (12 reviews, avg 1.4); Portfolio & reporting (7 reviews, avg 3.3)

**What users are saying**  
> Why does Groww not show exit load before I hit redeem? Charged 150 rupees on a 6 day holding. Hidden fees vibes.  
> Redeemed my mutual fund for an emergency expense at 11 days and somewhere ₹487 vanished between shown and received. Support took days to even tell me it was exit load. Rest of the experience is genuinely smooth.  
> App crashed twice during market hours today. Lost a good entry on a limit order.

**Key observation:** Mentions of the exit‑load fee fell from 32 in the first half of the window to 20 in the second half, but the proportion of confused users remained high (38 of 52 mentions, 73%). The drop likely reflects fewer redemptions as users adjust behavior, while the persistent confusion stems from the fee not being disclosed before the redemption step.

**Actions for the product team:**  
1. Add a pre‑redemption disclosure banner that shows the applicable exit load based on holding period.  
2. Include an inline tooltip on the redemption screen explaining the fee calculation and linking to a detailed FAQ.  
3. Implement a post‑redemption summary that itemises all charges, highlighting any exit load applied.
## 2. Fee explanation (reusable support snippet)

Use the text below verbatim when users raise this in tickets/chats.

# Support snippet: why my mutual fund redemption amount was less than expected (exit load)
*Audience: Users asking: “I redeemed my mutual fund and got less money than the NAV x units. Where did the amount go?”*

1. Exit load is a fee payable to the mutual fund house for exiting a fund before a specified period.
2. It applies when a redemption is made before the specified period, commonly within a year of investment.
3. Fund houses commonly charge around 1% exit load on redemption within a year; the exact rate is scheme-specific.
4. An approximate value of the exit load is shown while placing the redeem order.
5. The exit load amount displayed during the redeem order can be reviewed in the app’s order summary before confirming the transaction.

**Official sources**
- [Groww Help — What is exit load?](https://groww.in/help/mutual-funds/order/what-is-exit-load--71)
- [Groww Blog — Mutual Fund Fees and Charges in India](https://groww.in/blog/mutual-fund-fees-and-charges)
